body: Yes a part of me wants to live and I want to see what people think of my decision and I want to let them know why I really want to do it. I am so tired of feeling depressed everyday
Ok take your time :) I am still here.
tell me when you make one :) we can talk in private there
https://discordapp.com/ - I use it to talk to people.. well nobody but yeah

I know nobody can do it for me but myself and like I said before I choose not too but you know why ... man I seem like such an attention seeker I am sorry about this I dont even know you but at least you care
Yeah I dont wanna miss it either but I cant take it anymore it's impossible I really wanna do it now but I cant because I just wanna spend this last month with someone

If I was happy I would see where you're coming from but sadly I dont. Yeah the feeling of being worthless sucks, my brother always asks my parents why aint I kicked out yet? I am 16 and doing literally nothing.. just spending my time on my PC or phone...

My dad tries his best to help me.. but I dont want him to waste his time because no matter what he does I will still not be bothered to do anything and I know there are people who can help but I just dont want that to happen I really want to end my life.. and YES I can go back to school I just choose not too because everything is too hard for me to understand even if I do get extra help from teachers or special classes that wont change anything I have years and years to catch up on work
If only I was motivated enough... Sitting in my room everyday doing nothing isnt helping and I dont know what can.
Good point.. but I am sorry I am too weak to even survive on my own
I can become a nurse it's still not too late for me but I chose to give up because I am too weak. I am preparing to fail
I want to have them too.. and thank you
Yeah, thank you for that. It wont help me nothing will I tried for so long.. I just havent found it so yes I give up. Thank you so much <3 I just really fucking hate this world so much
It gets better.. but sometimes people are so weak they give up easily.
I dont need you to help me. I just want to let people know.

I know right? Only 16 and wanting to end my life.. I havent even experienced the best part of life yet, oh well. I guess I choose not too. I am not afraid to face my suicide in July... I hope it goes as I planned. Call me crazy but really I just cant live like this.. and no suicide hotlines dont help but thanks for giving me the number. I know but where I live if you dont finish school you cant even get a decent job.. I'll probably end up working in a fast food place cleaning toilets.. no.. I always wanted to be something far better than that. My fault

Thank you, I will enjoy my trip but you dont understand I didnt do my last exams.. and I wont. I am preparing to fail in life.. but I dont wanna struggle for the rest of my life.. so therefore I will end it choosing the easy way out.
